normal: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one standalone transparent 2D weapon sprite for Denti, a warm playful cartoon dental arena game. Input image 1 is the exact normal Mundspülungs-Mörser from the game's weapon atlas, and it is the sole edit target. Create its normal unenchanted version on a portrait 1024 x 1536 pixel RGBA canvas with a true transparent background. Preserve the original design, shape and visual identity: a chunky ivory-and-gold dental mortar with ONE clear green mouthwash reservoir mounted on top, a very wide hollow circular teal muzzle pointing diagonally up-right, and TWO separate downward handles: the rear left grip has a turquoise insert, the front right grip is red with gold bands. Keep the white tooth on the round turquoise medallion and the small red trigger, the original 3/4 view, all components' positions relative to each other, same diagonal barrel direction, painterly glossy cartoon shading and clean dark outlines. Do not redesign, mirror or rotate. Show the complete mortar centrally inside the portrait canvas with generous empty transparent padding: roughly x=0.08 to 0.94 and y=0.27 to 0.80; rear grip near (0.23,0.69), muzzle near (0.84,0.39). No spritz, no external liquid, no emitted projectile, no hand, no characters, no extra reservoirs, no floating pieces, no labels or text, no background color and no broad glow. Keep the distinctive broad mortar silhouette and visible TWO handles. This image becomes the shared framing reference for six elemental variants.
